title: Contains Duplicate
prompt:
Given an integer array `nums`, return `true` if any value appears **at least twice**, and `false` if every element is distinct.

**Example**: `[1,2,3,1]` → `true`; `[1,2,3,4]` → `false`.
hints: A HashSet remembers what you've seen with O(1) lookups.
`set.add(x)` returns false if x was already present — check it inline.

solution.explanation: O(n) time, O(n) space, early exit on the first repeat. Alternatives: sort first and compare neighbors (O(n log n), O(1) extra) — worth mentioning as the space-optimized trade.
